notes.title: Patch 1.9
notes.notes:
We have just released version 1.9! This update includes the following fixes:


 Fix to cards not prompting correctly in local pass and play matches
 Fixed issue where multiple retreat events during artillery fire could cause game to hang
 Improved AI targeting for artillery firing
 Improved retreat unit highlighting
 Added tutorial for crossfire attacks
 Fix to big show auto ending turn and skipping movement
 Fix to big show combined with some combat cards not applying the correct bonus per unit
 Fix to loading save files created in some previous versions
 Fix to in game briefing where this would lock up after consulting the in game manual
 Fix to replacements where player could be blocked from allocating all possible replacements
 Improved visuals for selecting cards to discard or keep
 Some visual improvements


~ The HexWar Games Team

notes.title: Patch v1.8
notes.notes:
In this latest update to the game, we've improved / fixed the following:
Fix to AI use of battle fury card.
Fix to retreat actions to ensure always completed.
Fix to return fire allowed when adjacent to enemy.
Fix to status icons appearing incorrectly.
Mortars can now be used to attack barbed wire hexes with no enemy present.
Interrupt type cards show as in play.
Fix to in game manual.
Improvement to AI when using rush and rotation card.
Improvement to AI use of advance over the top.
Improved lighting.

~ The HexWar Games Team

notes.title: Patch v1.7
notes.notes:
We have just released version 1.7! This update includes the following fixes:


 Additional option when playing counter intelligence card, allows valid cards to enter play the same turn
 Fix to counter intelligence card where card drawn from discard pile would appear as if played already, new card would never get applied
 Fix to some cards that appeared playable when they were not
 Fix to camera settings getting assigned correctly
 Fix to game log
 Fix to counter attack card
 Improvements to AI when choosing targets and attack order
 Fix to AI when using artillery, now uses correct amount of ammo
 AI some improvements to selecting cards, will not use artillery cards that leave no points for ammo
 Missed artillery attacks are clearer
 Lost messenger working against dice roll type cards
 Interface fix, block multiple orders to play an interrupt card. This was causing the game to become unstable
 Fix to in game manual for all platforms
 Reduced unit insignia and other minor interface improvements
 Improvement to dice physics, roll completes faster and is more contained
 Fix to victory medals, when removing more than one in a single action


We hope you continue to enjoy the game!

~ The HexWar Games Team

notes.title: Patch 1.5
notes.notes:
We have just released the fifth update for Command & Colors: The Great War. The following changes have been made:


 Performance improvements
 Fix for dice counting
 Fix to combat bonuses targeting incorrect units
 Fix to interrupt type cards getting prompted and played correctly
 Fix to targeting for some card combinations, eg. infantry assault with three on a match


We hope you continue to enjoy the game!

~ The HexWar Games Team

notes.title: Update v1.4
notes.notes:
We have just released the third update for Command & Colors: The Great War. The following changes have been made:

 Added more detail for unit status icons and unit HUD improvements
 Scenario specific bonuses are displayed in status icons
 Scenario trigger fixes
 Fix to Lost messenger, correctly plays agianst group select cards such as infantry assault
 Short supply destination can now be selected
 Mortar tooltip shows range as 5, corrected
 Achievements fixes for mine all mine and achievments that require accumulated dice rolls
 Counter intelligence now allows the full selection from discard deck
 Card display improvements
 Various text corrections
 Stability fixes

We hope you continue to enjoy the game!

~ The HexWar Games Team

notes.title: Update v1.3
notes.notes:
We have just released the third update for Command & Colors: The Great War. The following changes have been made:

 AI: Improved usage of Stretcher Bearer, Short Supply and Reserve Artillery
 Camera will now automatically centre on units that exit the battlefield
 Fix to Lost Messenger returning Combat Cards to hand
 Fix to Reserve Artillery inflicting retreats on the back row
 Units are now properly prevented from removing Wire after combat
 New unit Status Icons added, listed in the manual
 The manual's Card Reference now lists the quantity of each card
 Various text corrections
 Achievements for winning all scenarios as each side fixed - players who have already earned them should be rewarded by just starting the game

We hope you continue to enjoy the game!

~ The HexWar Games Team

notes.title: Update v1.2
notes.notes:
We have just released the second update for Command & Colors: The Great War. The manual is also now available to download from the Store Page as a PDF or by clicking  here .

In this patch the following issues have been fixed:


 Status icons for units correctly appear
 Status icons appear on restore
 Fixes to game manual
 Added section on unit status icons
 Scenario text fixes
 Trench raid always finds correct start hex for unit
 Fix to playing counter attack after big show
 Camera pan works better
 Camera option display in menu correctly
 Stability fixes
 Improved tooltips, more responsive mouse over
 Fix to retreat actions sometimes blocking end turn and locking game
 Fix to shell craters being restored when in scenario from start
 Removed lice icon for clarity
 Music level improvement
 Fix to artillery fire getting skipped
 Fix to artillery sometimes presenting invalid default shell count
 Block playing combat espionage card when opponent has no combat cards
 Fix to big show where player could select many units
 Fix to ai use of improved logistics
 Fix to ai playing big show and sometimes getting locked with unit selection
 Fix so that command card bonuses always applied before combat card bonus, could result in combat bonus getting discarded


We hope you continue to enjoy the game!

~ The HexWar Games Team

notes.title: Update v1.1.3
notes.notes:
We hope you're all enjoying playing Command & Colors: The Great War! We've just released the first patch which addresses several issues:
When choosing between Combat Cards or HQ tokens at end of turn, the current Combat Cards in your hand are now shown.
Fix to text box only allowing a single line of input when reporting issues.
"Bleed them White" achievement can no longer be won during opening 2 scenarios when this is the only path to victory.
Fix to units cached from previous turn on some autosaves.
Fix to potential crash when AI plays the artillery bombard card with low HQ tokens.
Fixed Reposition card move after attack bonus where this would be overlooked.
Fixes to text and formatting.
Various corrections to scenarios.
~ The HexWar Games Team
